name: Barbell Zercher Squat
steps: Cradle a barbell snugly in the crooks of your bent elbows with forearms folded toward your chest and hands clasped or clenched.
Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, brace your core tightly, and lift your chest.
Bend your hips and knees together and lower between your feet while keeping your heels grounded and the bar secure.
Drive firmly through your midfoot and heels to stand tall without letting your upper back round.
tips: Keep your elbows close together and lifted slightly so the bar stays secure.
Wrap a folded towel around the center of the bar if the bare shaft feels uncomfortable in your elbows.
